correctness.rationale: Both full-branch inverses and their 1/2 conditional weights are exact. The centered-coordinate transfer matrix gives the displayed resolvent determinant and cofactor. The eigenvalue polynomial excludes moduli >=1, its only possible real eigenvalue is zero (odd dimensions), and absence of a positive real correlation pole proves infinitely many sign reversals by Pringsheim. Evaluating the rational function at one gives exact zero positive-lag sum. Pointwise \(f=d+h\circ F-h\), \(Pd=0\), and \(\int d^2dm=1/3\) yield the CLT under published ergodicity, with bounded coboundary remainder. Exact forward-integration branch checks (346 rational identities) independently test finite cases; they are not used to certify the all-dimensional theorem.

value.rationale: The first physical coordinate is a natural observable of the vortex-inspired twisted baker model in any dimension, with no arbitrary parameter slice. The theorem identifies a structurally unexpected coexistence: positive lag-one memory, infinitely many sign reversals, yet an exact zero aggregate serial correction and Gaussian diffusivity equal to its instantaneous variance, independent of dimension. The rational function supplies all lag correlations and the explicit bounded martingale--coboundary identity explains why this happens. It is a specific useful dynamical statistical invariant, not merely a general CLT restatement.
